title: The Real Cost of Owning a Truck in 2026: 5 Hidden Costs (One Is $4,422 a Year)
description:
Sixteen thousand, four hundred forty-nine dollars. That is what AAA says it costs, every single year, to own and drive a new half-ton pickup in twenty twenty-six. Not the price of the truck. The cost of keeping it. And the biggest piece of that bill never shows up on a receipt, never comes in the mail, and most owners never even notice it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

14:24 Adding it all up

20:51 Your checklist for 2027
